description.en: Sets or clears a temporary map bit flag. Without a second argument the flag is set. Temporary map bit flags are a table of 32 bits (numbers 0 to 31) in the flag data, meant by their name for the current map. A number outside that range makes the game report an error, and the bit is still written past the table.
true to set the flag, false to clear it.

true (also when the flag data is not available and nothing is written).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Something done once on this map (not found in script_clean/; invented)
